title: InstanceInfo
description: Returned by the Core capability-discovery operation. Normative.

protocol_version.description: Semver of the protocol this instance implements.

items.description: Known set: remote, skills, artifacts, questions, mcp, schedules. Unknown (future) profiles are permitted and MUST be ignored by clients that don't recognize them (Foundation §6.2).

profiles.description: Optional profiles implemented beyond mandatory Core.

models.description: Available models; also served in full by listModels.

namespace.description: Tool namespace prefix; tools surface as `<namespace>_<tool>`.

host_toolkits.description: Native, non-portable host-language toolkits this variant exposes (declared for feature-detection; tools namespaced + access-gated). Absence ⇒ none. A Core-only persona/skill declaring no host-toolkit dependency runs on any variant.

transports.description: Transports this instance's MCP client supports. Wire details defer to the MCP spec.

mcp.description: Present when the `mcp` profile is implemented. Server management (add/remove/configure, health) is implementation-defined.

profile_versions.description: Optional per-profile semver map (M1); lets a client detect a profile's version independently of protocol_version.

required.description: Whether this instance mandates an API key. A remote client reads this before presenting a key (Api §3).

scheme.description: Authentication scheme; the only defined value is `bearer` (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`).

auth.description: Optional authentication contract for the remote surface. A `remote` instance SHOULD populate this; a client reads `auth.required` before presenting a key. Absent on Core/embedded (no auth).

max_page_size.description: Largest page size the instance will honor for paginated list operations.

max_payload_bytes.description: Largest accepted request body in bytes; oversized requests fail `413 payload_too_large`.

max_content_bytes.description: Largest single Content upload in bytes (putContent).

rate_limit.description: Optional rate-limit descriptor; shape is implementation-defined. Null or absent ⇒ unspecified.

limits.description: Optional operational limits. A `remote` instance SHOULD populate this so a client can size uploads and pages before issuing them.

base_path.description: URL path prefix under which the API surface is mounted (e.g. `/` or `/v0`).

api_major.description: Major version tag of the wire API, letting a client locate/select the surface independently of `protocol_version`.

api.description: Optional locator for the wire API surface; a remote client uses `base_path`/`api_major` to find the operations.

builtin_toolkits.description: Optional list of the portable built-in toolkits this variant offers (e.g. `shell`, `fs`, `web`). Lets a constrained variant (e.g. mobile) omit `shell`. Distinct from `host_toolkits` (native, non-portable). Absence ⇒ unspecified, not empty.

dialect.description: Identifier of the cron dialect this instance's scheduler parses (e.g. `posix-5field`, `quartz`, `vixie`). Advertised so a client knows whether a `ScheduledTask.cron` string is portable. Absent ⇒ dialect unspecified/opaque.

schedules.description: Present when the `schedules` profile is implemented. Optional hint describing the scheduler's cron dialect so a client can judge portability of `cron` expressions.
